title: What Ahmed Can Do
gist_ar: أحمد بيحكي عن قدراته وهواياته ووقت فراغه.
text: Ahmed can swim very well. He goes to the sea every weekend. He can't drive a car, because he is young. He loves playing football with his friends. In his free time he likes reading and drawing. He can sing a little, but he can't dance. His sister can ride a bike. She enjoys music. Together they play games. It is fun.

questions.q: What can Ahmed do very well?
questions.q_ar: أحمد بيقدر يعمل إيه كويس جدًا؟

questions.q: What does he like doing in his free time?
questions.q_ar: بيحب يعمل إيه في وقت فراغه؟
